```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(arrow)
library(glue)
library(fs)
library(bowerbird)
## GitHub repo details -------------------------------------------------------
gh_owner <- "mdsumner"
gh_repo  <- "aad-filelist"
gh_raw   <- glue("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{gh_owner}/{gh_repo}/main")
## Release assets are at:
## https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/releases/download/latest/{id}.parquet
release_base <- glue("https://github.com/{gh_owner}/{gh_repo}/releases/download/latest")
```

```{r load-sources}
## Source each sources/*.R to extract metadata without running a sync.
## Each file defines a single `src` object (a bb_source tibble).
source_files <- fs::dir_ls("sources", glob = "*.R")

source_meta <- map_dfr(source_files, function(f) {
e <- new.env(parent = baseenv())
  ## suppress package load messages
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(source(f, local = e))
  s <- e$src
  tibble(
    source_file  = fs::path_file(f),
    id           = s$id[[1]],
    name         = s$name[[1]],
    description  = s$description[[1]],
    doc_url      = s$doc_url[[1]],
    license      = s$license[[1]]
  )
})
```

```{r read-parquets, eval=TRUE}
## Try to read the first row of each Parquet asset to get last sync time.
## Falls back gracefully if the asset doesn't exist yet.
get_parquet_meta <- function(id) {
  url <- glue("{release_base}/{id}.parquet")
  result <- tryCatch({
    df <- read_parquet(url)
    list(
      n_files     = nrow(df),
      sync_time   = format(max(df$sync_time, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC"),
      parquet_url = url
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(
      n_files     = NA_integer_,
      sync_time   = "not yet synced",
      parquet_url = url
    )
  })
  result
}

parquet_meta <- map(source_meta$id, get_parquet_meta)

## extract each field as a plain vector rather than relying on map_int/map_chr
## on a list-of-lists, which is fragile when fallbacks are involved
summary_tbl <- source_meta |>
  mutate(
    n_files     = vapply(parquet_meta, `[[`, integer(1), "n_files"),
    sync_time   = vapply(parquet_meta, `[[`, character(1), "sync_time"),
    parquet_url = vapply(parquet_meta, `[[`, character(1), "parquet_url"),
    source_url  = glue("{gh_raw}/sources/{source_file}")
  )
```

This repo provides per-collection file-listing caches for Antarctic regional
climate model output.  Each collection is defined in its own R file using
[bowerbird](https://docs.ropensci.org/bowerbird/), and the resulting file
manifest is published here as a Parquet file for each release.

**To use a manifest in R:**

```r
arrow::read_parquet(
  "https://github.com/AustralianAntarcticDivision/aad-filelist/releases/download/latest/cordex-polarres-ant12-hclim-dmi.parquet"
)
```

---

```{r table, eval=TRUE}
summary_tbl |>
  transmute(
    Collection = glue('<a href="{doc_url}">{name}</a>'),
    Description = description,
    `R source` = glue('<a href="{source_url}"><code>{source_file}</code></a>'),
    `Parquet cache` = glue('<a href="{parquet_url}"><code>{id}.parquet</code></a>'),
    `Files listed` = ifelse(is.na(n_files), "—", as.character(n_files)),
    `Last synced` = sync_time
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
                            full_width = TRUE)
```
